title: Finish-method target structure + all-division environment audit V1
body:
Descriptive, model-independent reference for KO/TKO, submission and decision environments before MOV1 design. Starts at exact main 44aa8dc97b57192ae90e847767051a03f38acd3d. Categories and comparisons were frozen in commit 6264fc89e9c493f0fd5a6d2cdbde87f98c9598f0 before outcome aggregation.

Reconciles 5,658 eligible UFC bouts (2015-01-03–2026-08-15): 1,812 KO/TKO, 1,010 submission, 2,836 decision including 45 draws; 71 explicit exclusions. Includes every canonical division and separate Catch Weight reference, fixed four-era and 3/5-round views, all 15 exact #113 archetypes, all 17 existing state concepts, immutable terrain, Wilson intervals, separate conditional-denominator sample gates, missingness, and bounded cross-tabs.

The evidence supports KO-heavy HW/LHW structure surviving three-round restriction and submission enrichment in existing grappling panels; it also records temporal uncertainty, composition effects and insufficient cells. No causal/predictive claims.

Durable evidence: governance/finish_method_target_structure_v1/ — 23 tables, exact population/exclusions, report, MOV1/partial-pooling/hybrid implications, contract and hashes. Human interpretations are separate from generated tables. Future consumers may read V1 but must not silently edit it or convert it into features.

body:

Population: 5,658 modern eligible bouts (1,812 KO, 1,010 SUB, 2,836 DEC), including 2,822 conditional finishes. Outer 2018–2026 scoring: 4,260 bouts; conditional metrics: 2,115 finishes. Exact outer/inner class counts and ordered fight-ID hashes are committed. title: MOV1 conditional KO vs submission — first frozen run V1
body:
Executes merged #118 exactly, with no changes to F02, MOV0, terrain, archetypes, the structural audit or the MOV1 contract.

Starting main: `b6a644d9ef8d267f7d7da97f21e691f2bae99226`.
Implementation frozen before historical fitting: `31008e323d0ac579c8b93d810918c23ff15df5a1`.
Evidence head: `83822191168a94f4a0eef2b9f26295c0b9492b5b`.
Contract manifest SHA256: `9034e647bebaa7099f5358ed7a5db0e1bc515df1894db912274e5dae629cb714`.

## Result

| Conditional surface | Log loss | Brier | Three-way system | Multiclass log loss | Summed Brier |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|
| C0 | 0.651593 | 0.229507 | S0 | 0.993740 | 0.594575 |
| C1 | 0.641605 | 0.224829 | S1 | 0.988782 | 0.592501 |
| MIN | 0.615366 | 0.213614 | S2 | 0.975754 | 0.586206 |
| FULL | 0.619689 | 0.215100 | S3 | 0.977901 | 0.586869 |

Conditional MIN beyond C1: **CLEAR_SUCCESS** (9/9 favorable years; delta−0.026239; fight95 [−0.037958,−0.013835], event95 [−0.037655,−0.014047]).
Composed S2 beyond S1: **CLEAR_SUCCESS** (9/9 favorable; delta−0.013027; fight95 [−0.018826,−0.007284], event95 [−0.018882,−0.006961]).
FULL increment over MIN: **CURRENT_SPECIFICATION_NOT_SUPPORTED** (7/9 worse years; conditional/composed Brier worse; composed fight interval barely crosses zero, event interval slightly positive).

These are separate conclusions. Shared frozen F makes conditional and composed log-loss deltas algebraically related; classwise calibration and multiclass Brier add distinct checks.

## Limitations

MIN calibration slope0.831, ECE0.0314 and mean conditional KO66.3% versus actual64.3%. B3/B5 shift toward submission but remain about9 conditional percentage points too KO-heavy. Women's Strawweight is less well matched than C1. S2 submission ECE worsens versus S1 despite better aggregate log loss/Brier. Decision-node probabilities remain unchanged and overpredict prevalence by2.32 points. FULL was retained unchanged; no posthoc removal, tuning or recalibration.

## Verification and evidence

All exact inputs/allowlists/fold counts/ID hashes pass. Modern eligibility: 2,822 finishes (1,812 KO /1,010 SUB); outer scoring4,260, conditional evaluation2,115. All216 inner and27 outer fits converge, max56 iterations, zero solver warnings. Swap error0; representative MIN2021 refit identical float64 in the pinned environment; every persisted binary/composed probability regenerates with max error0. Composition sum error1.11e−16; no dropped rows or outcome-dependent scoring. Five synthetic guardrail tests pass.

86 run evidence files include36 fitted records, all surface/system predictions, preprocessing/solver/swap/selection records, conditional/composed metrics and calibration, annual paired uncertainty, all-division/archetype/terrain tables, fixed buckets, coefficients, pathway decomposition and simulator interpretation. [Independent full CI reproduction passed](https://github.com/Tkcool28/ufc-edge/actions/runs/36815096908): immutable input verification, five guardrail tests, saved-model regeneration, complete frozen rerun, and both full prediction-table comparisons within atol=1e-12, rtol=0. All 85 manifest-listed evidence files were also rechecked against their recorded SHA256 hashes.

- [Final report](models/mov1/run_v1/MOV1_KO_VS_SUBMISSION_GIVEN_FINISH_V1_REPORT.md)
- [Separate conclusions](models/mov1/run_v1/INTERPRETATION.md)
- [Pathway decomposition](models/mov1/run_v1/PATHWAY_DECOMPOSITION_REPORT.md)
- [Evidence manifest](models/mov1/run_v1/EVIDENCE_MANIFEST.json)

title: MOV1 three-family finish-pathway audit V1 — frozen evidence, zero fits
body:
Recovers the individual XGBoost, LightGBM and CatBoost finish-pathway evidence from PR #121 without training, rescoring, changing predictions or selecting a production winner. BOOST-SELECT remains INCONCLUSIVE.

**Dependency:** stacked on unmerged draft #121 at exact head `859be9fad8a1a95cf35f3e5bb99107205734ddce`. Main remains `4ec01227a4a35872eed51ce7ce67c45b02e46ebd`. This PR changes only audit reports, the read-only runner, independent verifier/test and zero-fit CI; no original model, feature, terrain or data artifacts change. Do not merge automatically.

The central report gives separate KO probability, conditional log loss and Brier matrices. All 15 frozen archetypes retain MATCH/NO_MATCH/UNASSIGNABLE, every division and immutable terrain, annual/configuration coverage, fixed buckets and independent finish sample gates. It also retains B3/B5 focused analyses, all qualifying primary-cell fight-level differences, 32 prediction-selected examples (including errors), paired fight/event intervals and family-composed systems.

Key findings:
- All shadows improve pooled conditional LL/Brier and ECE descriptively; all improve LL in 7/9 years, but all aggregate paired intervals span zero.
- All improve B3 individual LL/Brier while worsening its mean KO bias (MIN 55.2%, XGB 57.5%, LGBM 57.1%, CAT 57.2%; actual 46.0%).
- All move B5 toward submission and improve losses. CAT has the strongest observed B5 shift and lowest B3/B5 losses, without a confirmation/promotion claim.
- XGB has the strongest observed A1/A4 loss preservation. All improve Heavyweight; all worsen men's/women's Flyweight LL. A1 improves 5/9 years per family; A4 improves 7/9 XGB/LGBM and 3/9 CAT.
- Exact SELECT/shadow equality by selected year and inner/outer differences are documented. Better shadows do not prove selector instability.
- Existing importance/co-use cover SELECT folds only. No causal or shadow-wide interaction claim is made.

Validation: all three pinned manifest digests match; 189 source artifacts, 16 evaluation archive members and 3,987 native members verified. Same 4,260 scoring fights / 2,115 actual finishes for every surface. Independent verifier checks 660 cells, source/composed probabilities and reproduces all aggregate LL/Brier fight/event bootstrap intervals to 1e-12. Direct local regression test and staged whitespace check pass. No boosted libraries or predictive fit/train/predict calls are used. New CI runs the independent test with evaluation-only dependencies.

Evidence: `docs/model_diagnostics/mov1_three_family_finish_pathways_v1/` — start with `FINAL_AUDIT_REPORT.md` and `THREE_FAMILY_FINISH_PATHWAY_COMPARISON.md`. 49 audit artifacts plus their manifest; no native binaries duplicated.

title: Ground opportunity V1: source coverage and competing-pathway feasibility audit
body:
UFC EDGE has historical positional measurements, but their semantics and coverage do not support a defensible ground-opportunity mechanism experiment yet. This audit concludes **B — EXTERNAL GROUND-EXPOSURE SOURCE REQUIRED**.

The existing UFCStats/Greco counts support strict-prior descriptive activity proxies. Official UFC.com FightMetric material contains 32,156 fighter-round position rows across 6,803 fights, but positional times are coarse floor-minute buckets rather than exact seconds. Ground buckets disappear after 2020; complete prior ground-bucket histories cover only 22.51% of unique conditional training fighters at the 2018 boundary and 6.18% at 2026. Generic CTRL cannot substitute for common grounded duration.

This adds all eight requested reports, chronological 2018–2026 coverage/support tables, frozen B3/B5 descriptive diagnostics, source identities, reproducible scripts, pinned requirements, and the completion marker under `docs/data_audits/ground_opportunity_competing_pathways_v1/`. B3/B5 definitions and PR #125 predictions remain frozen. Sparse submission conversion ratios are withheld, including the observed conflict of submission wins with zero recorded attempts.

Validation: source and saved-evaluation hashes verified; strict event-date prior chronology and future-stat mutation invariance passed; 15 existing elapsed-exposure tests passed; 14 measurement outputs independently reproduced byte-identically; support-bin conservation and artifact-manifest checks passed; whitespace check passed. The published Git tree matches the locally verified tree. Frozen source/model/feature artifacts are unchanged. Current 2026 source snapshots do not establish historical publication vintages.
